paite: Huan Hezekiah in Israel gam leh Judah gam teng ah mi asawl a, Ephraim leh Manasseh gamte ah leng TOUPA Israel' Pathian a ding in Paikan Ankuang nei ding a Jerusalem a TOUPA' inn a hong pai ding in lai akhak hi.
heading: Paikan Kut Kisakkholhna

paite: Kumpipa leh amiliante leh Jerusalem a mipi teng in akha nihna ah, Paikan Ankuang neih asawm uhi.
Huai lai in alui thei nai kei ua, siampu kihihsiangthoute atam nai kei uh; Jerusalem a mipi akikaihkhop nai louh ziak un.
Athil sawm uh kumpipa leh mipite ngaih in adik hi.

Huchi in Israel gam teng, Beer-sheba a kipan Dan pha in TOUPA Israel' Pathian a ding in Paikan Ankuang nei ding a Jerusalem a hong pai ding apuang ding in thu ahihkipta hi. Adan bangtak in huchibang a tam in ahih ngei nai kei uh.

Huchi in lai taipih mite kumpipa leh amiliante uh lai tawi in, Israel leh Judah gam tengteng a pai ding in kumpipa thupiak bang in apawt ua, "Nou Israel suante aw, Siria kumpipate khut a kipan pawt a akhosuaksunte TOUPA, Abraham, Isak leh Israel' Pathian lam hong nga nawn un; huchi a nou lam ahong ngat nawn theihna ding in.
Nou zaw na pi-le-pute uh leh na unaute uh, TOUPA apipute uh Pathian tung a thil hihkhial a om, segawp ding a donsak lou a na muhte uh bang in om kei un.

Na pi-le-pute uh bang in genhak nawn kei unla, TOUPA kiang ah kitulut zaw unla, tangtawn a dia ahihsiangthou, amun siangthou ah hong lut unla, TOUPA na Pathian uh nna sem un, huchi in ahehna thupitak na lak ua kipan akiheimangsak ding hi.

TOUPA lam na hong ngat nawn uleh na unaute uh leh na tate uh sal a man mite'n ahehpih ding ua, hiai gam ah ahong pai nawn ding uhi. TOUPA na Pathian uh lah chingtheitak leh zahngaitheitak ahi ngal a, amah lam na hong ngat peuhmah uleh ahon nuse kei ding,” chi in.
Huchi in lai taipih mite kho chih ah Ephraim leh Manasseh gam tengteng ah Zebulun pha in apai ua, himahleh amaute nuihsan in ana simmoh uhi.
Himahleh Asherte leh Manassehte leh Zebulunte tampi akitulut ua, Jerusalem ah ahoh uhi.
Judah gamte ngial houh TOUPA thu a kumpipa leh miliante thupiak zui ding in Pathian in lungsim mun khat apusak hi.
Huchi in kha nihna ah tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ankuangluina nei ding in Jerusalem ah mi tampi ahong kikhawm ua, atam mahmah uhi.
heading: Paikan Kut Zatna

paite: Huan athou ua, Jerusalem a maitamte ala ua, gimlim halna maitamte leng ala ua, Kidron lui ah apai uhi.
Huchi in akha nihna ani sawm-le-li ni in Paikan Ankuangluina agou ua; siampute leh Levite azum ua, akihihsiangthou ua, halmang thillat toh TOUPA' inn ah alalut uhi.
Huan Pathian mipa Mosi Dan bangtak in amau mun chiat ah adingh ua; siampute'n Levite a kipan atan uh sisan atheh uhi.
Mipi lak ah lah kihihsiangthou lou atam ua; huaiziak in TOUPA a ding a hihsiangthou ding in asiangthouloute tuam ding in Levite'n Paikan Ankuangluina ding agou uhi.
Ephraim, Manasseh, Issakar, Zebulun mite tampi akihihsiangthou kei na ua, dan lou bang in Paikan Ankuangluina ane uhi. Himahleh amaute a ding in Hezekiah athum a, "Chingthei ToUPA'N,
Michih alungtang a TOUPA, apipute Pathian, Pathian zongte, mun siangthou siansakna dan dungzui in kisiangsak kei mahleh, ngaidam hen," chi in.
Huchi in TOUPA'N Hezekiah thumna angaikhia a, mipite ahihdamta hi.
Israel mi Jerusalem a omte'n Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ankuangluina nuamsatak in ni sagih azang ua; Levite leh siampute'n kaihging ngaihtak toh TOUPA pahtawi a la sa in niteng in TOUPA aphat uhi.
Huan Hezekiah in siamtak in TOUPA kilawmtak a phat Levite alungmuan hi. Huchi in TOUPA apipute uh Pathian kiang a thupha tawi in lemna thillatte lan in ni sagih ankuangluina ane tawntung uhi.
Huan mipi in ni sagih dang ankuang lui nawn asawm ua; huchi in ni sagih dang nuamsatak in ankuang alui nawn uhi.
heading: Paikan Kut Lop Hun Behlapna

paite: Huan Judah kumpipa Hezekiah in mipite bawngtal sangkhat leh belam sangsagih goh ding in apia a; miliante'n mipite bawngtal sangkhat leh belam singkhat apia uhi; siampu tampite akihihsiangthou uhi.
Huchi in Judah mipi tengteng siampute toh Levite toh, Israel gam a kipan a mipi hong pai tengteng leh namdang Israel gam a kipan a hong pai Judah gam a omte'n nuam asa mahmah uhi.
Huchi in nopsakna thupitak Jerusalem ah a-om a: Israel kumpipa David tapa Solomon chiang ah huchibang himhim Jerusalem ah a-om ngei nai kei hi.
Huchi in siampu leh Levite athou ua, mipite avualzawl ua; a-aw uh ngaihkhiak in a-om a, athumna un a-omna siangthou van apha hi.
